content: Cloud TTS latency UX pitfalls: total latency must stay under 700-1000ms for natural feel, real-world latency far exceeds vendor claims (ElevenLabs 75ms claim vs 400-600ms actual from distant regions), latency is sum of network RTT + synthesis time + client buffering, streaming TTS reduces time-to-first-byte significantly vs waiting for full synthesis, geographic region selection matters (100-150ms TTFB from nearby vs much higher from distant regions), cold starts add delay (send keepalive requests every 5-10min), compressed audio formats (MP3) reduce transfer time vs WAV.
